payload.text: On the one wire contract, a perpetual-option instrument must carry `expiry_years == 0` (a perpetual has no expiry): `validate_perpetual_terms` rejects any non-zero value with `WireError::InvalidTerms`. Because the check is `expiry_years != 0.0` (which is also true for NaN), a NaN expiry is rejected, never silently waved through as "no expiry". Pure: it reads only its `f64` argument and returns a `Result`, mutating nothing.
